summary: Frontend testing of multi-drop parcel delivery (/parcel) for SB Drive VTC. All 4 choice buttons present. Multi mode: pickup btn, initial stop with recipient/phone fields, add-stop btn all working. Add/remove of stops works correctly (re-indexing OK). Map placement → estimate → confirm → success → /history redirect all functional. Single mode correctly hides add-stop and recipient fields. Fixed a CRITICAL Leaflet container height=0 bug (MapContainer needed inline style height) — without this fix, the map cannot be clicked.

ui_bugs.issue: Leaflet container rendered with height:0 because className='h-full' on .leaflet-container did not resolve a usable height (parent flex chain rooted at min-h-screen). Map was invisible and unclickable, blocking entire multi-drop flow. Fixed by adding style={{height: '100%', minHeight: '240px'}} on MapContainer.

action_items: Review the inline style applied on MapContainer in /app/frontend/src/pages/user/ParcelPage.js (line ~151) — keep or refactor to a CSS class. Consider checking other Leaflet maps in the app for the same h-0 issue.
critical_code_review_comments: Per-leg breakdown shows recipient_name when provided — works as expected.
After successful POST /api/parcels, the success screen flashes briefly (~2.5s) before navigate('/history'); consider a slightly longer timeout for visibility.
Leaflet h-full pattern is fragile inside min-h-screen+flex containers — prefer explicit pixel/vh heights or set a parent with h-screen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-drop parcel flow works end-to-end. Verified: 4 choice buttons, multi-moto opens map screen with pickup/stop-0/add-stop, recipient fields appear only in multi mode, add stop creates parcel-stop-1/2 with parcel-stop-remove-1, removal reindexes correctly, map click places markers, estimate button enables once pickup+all stops placed, confirm screen shows stops count, total fare, per-leg breakdown, confirm POSTs and redirects to /history. The MapContainer needed style={{height:'100%', minHeight:'240px'}} — without it the leaflet-container has height 0.
rca of the issue: Bug: Leaflet map invisible/unclickable on /parcel map screen. Reproduction: login → /parcel → multi-moto-btn → map screen shows empty white area instead of map tiles. Cause: <MapContainer className='w-full h-full'> resolves to a .leaflet-container with height:0 because the ancestor flex chain (mobile-container is min-h-screen, not h-screen) does not pass an explicit height down through flex-1. Mitigation applied: added style={{height:'100%', minHeight:'240px'}} to MapContainer to force the leaflet-container to take the parent's available height (parent has min-h-[240px]).
